en: The image shows the address side of an old postal card with multilingual headings for 'Postcard' (German, French, Italian, English, Hungarian, Slavic languages, etc.) and the phrase 'Union postale universelle Weltpostverein Unione postale universale'. It bears two postage stamps on the left side (one green, one orange) with Cyrillic inscriptions and circular black cancellation marks. There are additional round postmarks in black ink on the right side, with a visible date that appears to be 1904 or 1906 and Cyrillic place names. The center is filled with handwritten address text in cursive Cyrillic script.
